name: waybar-ai-usage
description: Monitor Claude Code, OpenAI Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, and OpenCode Zen usage directly in your Waybar status bar. Shipped to AUR.

name: renpak
description: AVIF compression toolchain for Ren'Py games. Shrinks RPA archives by re-encoding images to AVIF — games load them transparently at runtime, no engine patches needed.

name: pikpak-kotlin
description: A Kotlin Multiplatform SDK for PikPak cloud storage. Handles session persistence, captcha auth, rate limiting, and resumable uploads. Extracted from the Animeko PikPak work.

name: animeko-pikpak
description: Animeko fork hosting the PikPak cloud offline-download integration. See PR #2978 for the upstream patch series.

name: anvil
description: Training, evaluation, and ONNX export pipeline for the ANVIL paper. INT8 quantization analysis; Qualcomm HTP and MediaTek NPU backends.

name: mpv-android-anvil
description: Companion Android player for the ANVIL paper. Vulkan + QNN/HTP + libplacebo. Real-time 30→60 fps frame doubling on Snapdragon SoCs.
